title: Meta can't stop states' $1.4 trillion lawsuit from going to trial
summary: Meta and TikTok tried to defeat thousands of social media addiction lawsuits in one fell swoop, but an appeals court rejected the attempt in a ruling issued yesterday. Therefore, we dismiss Meta’s and TikTok’s appeals,” judges wrote.
